page.title: Redesign Darv
section.top.title: Overview
section.top.notice: This mod only affects the relic distribution of the three Darv options for the five vanilla characters. Option 1: Runic Pyramid is checked first at 20%; Black Star / Empty Cage / Pandora's Box / Calling Bell / Astrolabe evenly share the remaining probability. Option 2: Runic Pyramid is checked first at 20%; Ectoplasm / Velvet Choker / Philosopher's Stone / Sozu / Snecko Eye evenly share the remaining probability. Runic Pyramid's overall chance is about 36%. Option 3: Dusty Tome at 50%; character relics evenly share the remaining 50%.
section.perCharacter.title: Per-Character Options
section.perCharacter.description: Toggle this mod per character. When disabled, that character falls back to the vanilla Darv design of the current game version. Unlisted characters (e.g. mod characters and not-yet-adapted new characters) always use the vanilla logic only. Unsaved changes do not take effect; after clicking "Save and Quit the Game", the settings apply immediately once the game is restarted.
toggle.ironclad.label: Ironclad
toggle.ironclad.description: Option 3 pool: Runic Cube + Mark of Pain.
toggle.silent.label: Silent
toggle.silent.description: Option 3 pool: Hovering Kite + Wrist Blade.
toggle.defect.label: Defect
toggle.regent.label: Regent
toggle.regent.description: Option 3 pool: Ancient Lunar Pastry + Ancient Mini Regent + Ancient Orange Dough. See the mod description for the full logic.
toggle.necrobinder.label: Necrobinder
toggle.necrobinder.description: Option 3 pool: Ancient Bookmark + Ancient Ivory Tile + Ancient Big Hat. See the mod description for the full logic.
section.swap.title: Swap Option
section.snecko.title: Whether Snecko Eye appears in that character's second option (default: on)
section.snecko.description: When off, Snecko Eye no longer appears in that character's second Darv option; the remaining four relics (Sozu / Ectoplasm / Philosopher's Stone / Velvet Choker) split the chance evenly when option 2 is not taken by Runic Pyramid. This option exists because Snecko Eye fits the Regent very poorly: his expensive cards are expensive in star cost rather than plain energy cost.
toggle.swap.label: Swap Mark of Pain with Nuclear Battery
toggle.swap.description: When enabled, Mark of Pain only appears for the Defect and Nuclear Battery only for the Ironclad in the 3 Darv options. This is allowed because the Ironclad's status-card system was ported to the Defect in Slay the Spire 2.
section.multiplayer.title: Multiplayer Notice
section.multiplayer.notice: Every player in a multiplayer run must install this mod. Multiplayer compatibility has not been carefully tested. Each player's relic distribution is generated from that player's own settings.
section.save.title: Save & Quit
section.save.notice: Please click the save button at the bottom. The settings are applied only after you quit and restart the game; otherwise your changes will not be saved.
button.saveAndQuit.label: Save & Quit
button.saveAndQuit.description: Saves your settings and quits the game automatically. Changes take effect immediately after the game is restarted.
